title: _task
description: A part of a _work, created by the engine from a step of the _process of that work. It is assigned to a role and may wait for sibling tasks. Draft v0.

type.description: Task type; values are defined at project level.

status.description: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS or DONE. OPEN while it waits for its turn (a `dependOn` is not DONE yet, or it has not started), IN_PROGRESS once the engine starts it, DONE when its work is finished.

assignee.description: A role, not an agent: the role of its step in the process.

dependOn.description: The sibling tasks, created from the steps it waits for; may be empty.

recoveries.description: How many times the recovery of the MCP server leader has touched this task to start it again. It is 1 at most: a task that was already recovered once is left for a person.

instructions.description: The instructions of the task, from the process or overridden by `customInstructions` of its work.
